description: A lightweight client-side mod for NeoForge 1.21.1 that adds borderless fullscreen to Minecraft, replacing the exclusive fullscreen toggle with a proper 3-mode system — plus a set of video and quality-of-life options Minecraft doesn't expose.

mods.name: Borderless Window
mods.description: Adds borderless fullscreen to Minecraft with a 3-mode system (Windowed / Borderless / Fullscreen) and configurable F11 behavior, plus a growing set of video and quality-of-life options Minecraft doesn't expose. Every setting defaults to vanilla behavior. Optional Sodium video settings integration. Configurable from the Mods menu, no dependencies required.
